title: ADR-006 verify — dev-up.sh auto-copies canonical bootstrap files to repo root
objective: Verify scripts/dev-up.sh, when root compose.yaml/.env.example are absent, copies the canonical backend/ files to the repo root, prints an env-banner notice, and proceeds — closing DEF-101/DEF-102 procedurally.
preconditions: Clean checkout state (root compose.yaml + .env.example absent); script source readable; Docker for full boot (else script-logic verification only).
steps: Inspect scripts/dev-up.sh: verify auto-copy logic for both files, idempotency (no clobber when root files exist), set -euo pipefail, and the notice banner.
If executable in this environment: run dev-up.sh from a simulated clean root; verify files materialize at root and script continues to stack startup (or fails only on Docker absence, after the copy).
Verify re-run does not overwrite a locally modified root .env.example (document clobber policy).
expected_result: Documented clean-checkout bootstrap works via auto-copy (ADR-006); canonical backend/ files untouched; behavior idempotent; DEF-101/DEF-102 closable (full boot evidence if Docker available, else script-logic evidence + BLOCKED note for boot).
automation_status: script inspection automatable; full boot requires Docker

title: DEF-103 disposition — uv.lock generated, or documented risk re-asserted with evidence
objective: Close DEF-103 if a uv-capable environment exists (uv.lock committed + consistent with pyproject); otherwise verify the ADR-003 documented-risk statement is current and accurate.
test_data: backend/uv.lock (presence), pyproject ranges, README ADR-003 note
steps: Check for backend/uv.lock; if present, verify it is tracked and satisfies pyproject ranges (and Dockerfile uses frozen install if documented).
If absent, verify README/ASSUMPTIONS still documents the deferral accurately (no uv + network in any available environment).
expected_result: Either lockfile committed (defect closed) or the documented-risk carry is re-verified as truthful for Cycle 3 (release statement must mention it).

title: DEF-005 disposition — npm-audit critical resolved, mitigated, or formally risk-accepted
objective: Record final Cycle-3 disposition of the Cycle-1 critical transitive dev dependency: fixed (lockfile shows patched version), removed, or a written risk-acceptance with justification (dev-only, not shipped, no exploit path in build output).
preconditions: frontend/package-lock.json; frontend README/ASSUMPTIONS; npm audit still not allowlisted (verified C2).
test_data: lockfile entries for the flagged package chain; documented risk decision text
steps: Inspect package-lock for the vulnerable package/version if identified in docs; check for upgrades vs the C1 finding.
Verify a written disposition exists (README/ASSUMPTIONS/release notes): fixed / not-exploitable-dev-only rationale / tracking.
If no disposition text exists and audit cannot run, file as release-blocking documentation gap.
expected_result: Explicit recorded disposition for the release; absence of both fix and rationale = FAILED with new defect (documentation/risk gap).
automation_status: automatable (file inspection); audit itself remains allowlist-blocked

title: Release readiness — gates green, OpenAPI drift-clean, docs current, defect register reconciled
objective: Final gate sweep for the release statement: all executable quality gates green on both sides, OpenAPI committed + drift guard passing, READMEs/ASSUMPTIONS/ADRs current through Cycle 3, and every defect in the register has a status (closed or recorded risk decision).
test_data: gate outputs; backend/openapi.json; READMEs; ASSUMPTIONS.md; defect register (DEF-001…006, DEF-101…103, DEF-005, any C3 defects)
steps: Run backend gates (ruff format/check, mypy, pytest) and frontend gates (lint, typecheck, test, build); capture outputs.
Verify OpenAPI drift guard green and schema includes C3 endpoints (reservations, approvals, notifications, reports, admin, retire/dispose/reopen, data-quality).
Review docs for C3 accuracy (bootstrap ADR-006, new modules, job ops, backup/restore).
Reconcile defect register: no open Critical/High without recorded risk decision.
expected_result: All gates green; contract current; docs accurate; defect register fully dispositioned per §17; QA can issue the release-readiness statement honestly (including residual BLOCKED/MANUAL items with their manual procedures).
